Creamy Tuscan Chicken 🍗✨ This creamy Tuscan chicken is packed with juicy seasoned chicken, garlic, spinach, and sweet grape tomatoes in a rich Parmesan cream sauce. It’s perfect served over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice! 😋  🍗 Creamy Tuscan Chicken Ingredients:  Chicken seasoning  * 2 to 3 chicken breasts, sliced in half * Salt & pepper * ½ tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes (optional) Sauce: * 1 tbsp butter * ½ onion, diced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved * 2 cups spinach * 1 cup heavy cream * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * Salt & pepper, to taste * Fresh parsley Directions: Season the chicken with all the spices. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the onion and garlic until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted. Pour in the heavy cream and Parmesan, stirring until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Return the chicken to the skillet and let simmer for 2–3 minutes. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice. Enjoy! 🤍

FLATBREAD WITH BUTTER CHICKEN #food #recipe #chicken #butterchicken #flatbread CHICKEN MIXTURE 25 g unsalted butter 20 ml sunflower oil 600 g chicken thighs, cut into cubes 5 g garam masala (1⅔ tsp) 2 g ground coriander (⅔ tsp) 2 g ground cumin (⅔ tsp) 3 g garlic powder (1 tsp) 4 g onion powder (1⅓ tsp) 2 g cayenne pepper (⅔ tsp) 30 g tomato paste 50 ml water 100 ml heavy cream 15 g honey 1 chicken stock cube 100 g grated cheese (Gouda) DOUGH 350 g all-purpose flour 50 g herb cream cheese 4 g salt (⅔ tsp) 6 g baking powder 170 ml water EXTRA cheese slices Heat the butter and sunflower oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the chicken thighs, garam masala, ground coriander, ground cumin, garlic powder, onion powder, and cayenne pepper. Fry for 5–6 minutes. Add the tomato paste, water, cream, and honey. Mix well and let simmer for 5–7 minutes until the sauce has slightly thickened. Crumble the chicken stock cube over the pan. Add the grated cheese and stir until creamy. Remove from the heat and let the chicken mixture cool completely. Place the flour, baking powder, herb cream cheese, salt, and water in a large bowl. Knead for 10–12 minutes until smooth. Cover and let the dough rest for 10 minutes. Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces of about 70 g each and shape into balls. Roll out a dough ball into a circle. Place a slice of cheese on one half and spread about 90 g of the chicken mixture on top. Lightly moisten the edges, fold the dough closed, and press the edges firmly to seal. Place the filled dough on a sheet of parchment paper. Heat a heavy-bottomed frying pan with a little oil. Cook the breads over medium-high heat until golden brown and cooked through on both sides. Tips Don’t cut the chicken too small. Cubes of about 2 cm give a better bite. Let the mixture thicken well. The sauce should be creamy and firm, not runny like a curry. Let it cool completely. A warm filling makes the dough soft and hard to seal. Letting the dough rest is important. Those 10 minutes make it more elastic and easier to roll out. Use any cheese you like. You can also bake these breads in the oven. Preheat the oven to 200°C (390°F) and bake for 15–20 minutes (brush with oil or butter). Add salt to taste. Preparation Time Chicken mixture preparation & cooling: 20 minutes Dough preparation & resting: 25 minutes Cooking: 10–15 minutes

Ingredients: •4 bone-in Chicken Thighs •2 tsp Lemon Pepper Seasoning •2 tsp Garlic Powder •2 tsp Smoked Paprika •1 tsp Kosher Salt •1 tsp Black Pepper •1 tsp Onion Powder •3 tbsp Olive Oil Sauce •2 tbsp Unsalted Butter •¼ cup Honey •4 slices of Lemon •4 tsp minced garlic •1 tbsp freshly squeezed Lemon Juice •2 tsp Low-Sodium Soy Sauce Instructions: Prepare the Chicken 1. Clean and pat the thighs dry. In a small bowl, combine the lemon pepper seasoning, garlic powder, paprika, salt, black pepper, and onion powder. Stir in the olive oil to make a seasoning paste. Fully coat the thighs with the paste, spreading it underneath the thigh skin to flavor the meat. Transfer the chicken to a zip-top bag or a container with a lid. Let the thighs marinate for at least 2 hours or up to overnight. 2. When the chicken is done marinating, preheat the oven to 425°F (215°C). Line a large baking pan or 9x13-inch (23x33cm) baking pan with foil, set a baking rack in the pan, and coat the baking rack with nonstick cooking spray. 3. Place the thighs on the rack skin side down. Bake, uncovered. for 30 minutes. Turn over the thighs and continue to bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until cooked through. The internal temperature should be at least 165°F (75°C). When cutting into the chicken near the thickest section, all of the juices should run clear. While the chicken is baking we can prepare the sauce. Prepare the Sauce 4. In a large skillet over medium-low heat, melt the butter. When the butter is melted, add the honey, lemon slices, garlic, lemon juice, soy sauce, and 1 tablespoon water. Bring the sauce to a simmer, then cook, periodically stirring the sauce until it thickens, about 5 minutes. 5. When the chicken is done, brush the sauce all over both sides and bake for an additional 5 minutes, until the sauce has browned and turned sticky. Allow the thighs to cool for 3 to 5 minutes, then enjoy! #royaleeats

Sticky Chicken Tender, seasoned chicken coated in a sweet and savory sticky sauce, served over warm rice and finished with green onions and sesame seeds. Ingredients For the Chicken 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces 1 teaspoon each onion powder, garlic powder, and teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon each black pepper and paprika  2 tablespoons olive oil About ⅓ cup cornstarch Olive oil, for cooking For the Sticky Sauce ½ cup soy sauce ⅓ cup brown sugar or honey 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce 1 tablespoon ketchup 1 teaspoon ginger paste ½ tablespoon minced garlic 1 tablespoon cornstarch 2 tablespoons butter For Serving Cooked white rice Sliced green onions Sesame seeds Instructions 1. Add the chicken to a large bowl and season with onion powder, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika. Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil and toss until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Sprinkle about ⅓ cup cornstarch over the seasoned chicken and toss until each piece is lightly and evenly coated. This helps give the chicken that tender, velvety texture and creates a great coating for the sauce. 3. In a bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, brown sugar or honey, hoisin sauce, ketchup, ginger paste, minced garlic, and 1½ tablespoons cornstarch until smooth. Set aside. 4. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken in 2 batches so you don't overcrowd the pan. Cook until golden brown on the outside and cooked through. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside. 5. Reduce the heat and add 2 tablespoons of butter to the same skillet, scraping up all those flavorful browned bits from the bottom of the pan. 6. Pour the prepared sauce into the skillet. Cook over low heat, whisking frequently, until the sauce begins to bubble and thickens into a glossy, sticky consistency. 7. Add the cooked chicken back to the skillet and toss until every piece is completely coated in the sticky sauce. 8. Spoon the sticky chicken over warm rice and finish with sliced green onion.  #easyrecipe #dinnerideas #quickrecipes #easydinner #dinnerrecipes

Chicken Au Poivre‼️ Full Video Things you need  Whole chicken Sherry Wine (Holland House Cooking Wine) 1 Large Shallot Minced Garlic (3-4 cloves) Heavy Whipping Cream, 2 - 2.5 cups Fresh Cracked Black Pepper Fresh Rosemary, chopped    Chicken Seasoning: Salt, Cracked Black Pepper, Onion Powder, Garlic Powder, Chili Powder, Paprika, Kinder’s Buttery Poultry Seasoning, Dried Parlsey  Sauce Seasoning: Salt, Cracked Black Pepper, Onion Powder, Garlic Powder Directions  1. Prepare the Chicken Clean the chicken using 1 part vinegar to 2 parts water. Remove the insides, then butterfly the chicken by cutting out the backbone with kitchen shears. Lay the chicken meat‑side up, pat dry, and press down firmly to flatten. Season generously with the listed seasonings, including salt and cracked black pepper on the underside. 2. Cook the Chicken Preheat the oven to 375°F. Heat a large skillet over medium‑high. Once hot, sear the whole chicken skin‑side down until browned, about 4–5 minutes per side. If cooking multiple chickens, repeat the process. Transfer the browned chicken(s) to a baking dish. Add about 1/3 cup water to the bottom of the dish, cover, and place in the oven while you prepare the sauce 3. Prepare the Sauce In the same skillet used for searing, add diced shallots, garlic, and chopped rosemary. Cook for 3–4 minutes, scraping up any browned bits from the chicken. Deglaze with 1/2 cup Sherry cooking wine and cook for 2–3 minutes. Add 2 – 2.5 cups heavy whipping cream, whisking to combine. Season with the listed sauce seasonings and cook for 3–4 minutes, whisking occasionally. 4. Finish the Dish Remove the chicken from the oven and pour the cream sauce over the top. Return to the oven and cook for 60–90 minutes, depending on the size of the chicken, or until the meat is tender and falling off the bone. Baste the chicken with the cream sauce every 30 minutes, stirring the sauce before each baste. For reference: a 3–4 lb chicken typically cooks in about 1 hour and 20 minutes. 5. Serve Serve the chicken over mashed potatoes or rice, and garnish with parsley. #cookingvideos #chickenaupoivre #recipes #fyp #mashedpotatoes

Makes 4 servings. 4 small chicken breasts (or 2 large cut in half) 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp Italian seasoning ½ tsp paprika ½ tsp garlic powder Salt and black pepper, to taste 3 cloves garlic, minced ¾ cup low-sodium chicken broth ⅓ cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes, drained 1 cup low-fat cottage cheese ½ cup fat-free milk ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese 2 cups fresh spinach Fresh basil, for garnish 1. Blend the cottage cheese and fat-free milk until completely smooth and creamy. 2. Season the chicken with the Italian seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the chicken for 4 minutes per side until golden. Transfer to a plate. 4. Reduce the heat to low-medium and cook the garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant. 5. Pour in the chicken broth, scraping up any browned bits from the pan. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes and simmer for 2-3 minutes. 6. Remove the skillet from the heat and let cool for about five minutes. 7. Slowly whisk the cottage cheese mixture into the skillet until smooth. (Make sure tomato mixture is cool enough before adding the cottage cheese to prevent curdling!) 8. Add the spinach and cook until wilted. Add Parmesan and mix until melted. 9. Return the chicken to the skillet and warm over low heat for 3-4 minutes. Garnish with fresh basil and enjoy! Recipe Name Honey Garlic Chicken with Creamy Parmesan Penne Ingredients 1. 2 large chicken breasts, sliced 2. 12 oz (340 g) penne pasta 3. 2 tbsp olive oil 4. 2 tbsp butter 5. 4 garlic cloves, minced 6. 1 tsp paprika 7. 1 tsp Italian seasoning 8. 1 tsp salt 9. 1/2 tsp black pepper 10. 1 cup heavy cream 11. 1 cup grated Parmesan cheese 12. 1/2 cup chicken broth 13. 1 tbsp honey 14. 1 tbsp soy sauce 15. 1 tsp Dijon mustard 16. 1 tbsp chopped parsley Recipe 1. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the penne until al dente. Drain and set aside. 2. Season the chicken with paprika, Italian seasoning, salt, and black pepper. 3. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sear the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and slice. 4. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant. 5. Stir in the honey, soy sauce, Dijon mustard, and chicken broth. Simmer for 2 minutes. 6. Add the heavy cream and cook over medium heat until slightly thickened. 7. Stir in the Parmesan cheese until smooth and creamy. 8. Toss the cooked penne into the sauce, coating every piece evenly. 9. Return the sliced chicken to the skillet and spoon some sauce over the top. 10. Simmer for 2 minutes to blend the flavors. 11. Garnish with chopped parsley and extra Parmesan if desired. 12. Serve hot with garlic bread or a fresh salad. Follow for more delicious and easy recipes!

Easy High Protein Honey BBQ Chicken Mac & Cheese🍯🍗🧀 59g Protein Meal Prep💪🏼 (Macros Per Serve, Makes 4 Servings) 587 Calories 67.5gC | 9gF | 59gP Like recipes like this? Check out my cookbooks! LINK IS IN MY BIO 👨🏻‍🍳📚 Ingredients: * 700g Diced Chicken Breast (raw weight) * 1 Tsp Each: Salt, Onion Powder, Smoked Paprika & Garlic Powder * 1 Tsp Olive Oil * 25g Honey * 85g Reduced Sugar or Sugar Free BBQ Sauce (Hughes Sugar Free BBQ Sauce or your preferred BBQ sauce) * 320g Macaroni Pasta (uncooked weight) * 340ml Fat Free Evaporated Milk (Carnation Light & Creamy 99% Fat Free) * 80g Light Cream Cheese * 1.5 Tsp Chicken Stock Powder * 100g Grated Light Cheddar Cheese (Dairyworks Natural Cheddar) Instructions: 1. Add the diced chicken breast to a bowl and season with salt, onion powder, smoked paprika & garlic powder. Drizzle over the olive oil and mix thoroughly until every piece is evenly coated in the seasonings. 2. Heat a pan over medium heat and add the seasoned chicken. Cook for approximately 4 minutes on each side or until golden on the outside and fully cooked through. 3. Reduce the heat to low, then add the honey and BBQ sauce directly to the pan. Toss the chicken through the sauce until every piece is coated in a thick & sticky honey BBQ glaze. Remove from the heat and set aside. 4. Meanwhile bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the macaroni according to the packet instructions until al dente. Drain the pasta and set aside. 5. For the cheese sauce add the evaporated milk, light cream cheese and chicken stock powder to a separate pan over medium low heat. Stir until the cream cheese has softened and combined with the milk then gradually add the grated cheddar. Continue stirring until melted into a smooth, rich & creamy cheese sauce. 6. Add the drained macaroni directly into the cheese sauce and mix everything together until the pasta is completely coated in that creamy, cheesy goodness. 7. Divide the honey BBQ chicken and mac & cheese evenly between 4 meal prep containers. Finish with some freshly chopped parsley if desired and enjoy! Meal Prep Pro Tip: Mac & Cheese naturally thickens as it cools because the pasta continues absorbing moisture from the sauce. When reheating add a small splash of milk and give everything a good stir to bring back that smooth, creamy consistency! Store in airtight containers in the fridge for up to 3 to 4 days, or freeze individual portions for longer storage. #macandcheese #mealprep #highprotein #healthyrecipes #chickenmacandcheese
